trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for EDUCATION.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- admissions_enquiry: Check eligibility against real criteria, report seat availability and progress an application.
- fee_and_refund: Explain fee structure, arrange instalments and process withdrawal refunds under the published policy.

Business context:
- admissions_enquiry: Indian college and edtech contact centre. Callers ask about eligibility, seats, fees and refunds. Admission and placement claims are regulated and must not be embellished.
- fee_and_refund: Indian college and edtech contact centre. Callers ask about eligibility, seats, fees and refunds. Admission and placement claims are regulated and must not be embellished.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [admissions_enquiry]
  - Criteria truth: Eligibility may only be stated from check_course_eligibility, never estimated from marks.
  - No admission promise: Submitting an application is not admission. The agent must not imply a seat is secured.
  - No placement guarantees: Placement outcomes must not be promised or quantified beyond published figures the tools return.
  - Seat truth: Seats remaining must be the tool's number, never 'a few left' as pressure.
  [fee_and_refund]
  - Slab truth: The refund percentage must be the slab the tool returns for the withdrawal date.
  - Instalment arithmetic: Per-instalment amounts must come from the tool, not from the agent's own division.
  - Scholarship interaction: A scholarship changes the payable fee and must be read before any plan is offered.
  - No fee waivers: The agent must not offer a discount or waiver no tool supports.

Tools available to you (7): check_course_eligibility, check_refund_slab, lookup_applicant, lookup_fee_account, setup_instalment_plan, submit_application, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: bn-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: check_course_eligibility
model_visible_tools.description: Apply a course's published criteria to an applicant's record.

model_visible_tools.name: check_refund_slab
model_visible_tools.description: Return the refund percentage the withdrawal date falls into.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_applicant
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve an applicant's qualification, marks and application state.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_fee_account
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve fees due, paid, instalment plan and the refund slab that applies.

model_visible_tools.name: setup_instalment_plan
model_visible_tools.description: Convert an outstanding fee into scheduled instalments.

model_visible_tools.name: submit_application
model_visible_tools.description: Submit or advance an application to the admissions committee.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Misreads domain terminology and asks for it in plain words.
Needs each instruction confirmed before moving on.
Cannot follow an app-based instruction without a spoken alternative.
Repeats what the agent said to check they understood.

steps.purpose: Ask about MBA eligibility and provide application ID.
steps.text: নমস্কার, আমার application id APP-1002. আমি কি MBA programme-এর জন্য qualify করি?

steps.purpose: Request identity verification factors.
steps.text: নমস্কার, আমি চেক করে দিচ্ছি। তার আগে verification-এর জন্য আপনার registered name আর date of birth-টা একটু বলবেন?

steps.purpose: Provide verification factors and ask for clarification on verification.
steps.text: হ্যাঁ, আমার নাম Rahul, আর date of birth 12th May 1999. আচ্ছা, verification মানে কি আমার identity check করছেন?

steps.purpose: Verify the caller's identity using the provided factors.
Return the result of the identity verification.
Retrieve the applicant's record to check their current details.
Return the applicant's record details.
Check if the applicant meets the criteria for the MBA programme.
Return the eligibility result for the MBA programme.
Begin explaining the eligibility result, setting up for the user to interrupt.
steps.text: ধন্যবাদ Rahul বাবু। আমি আপনার details চেক করলাম। আপনার BCom-এ aggregate percent 58% আছে, কিন্তু MBA-এর জন্য minimum...

steps.purpose: Interrupt the agent to ask for clarification on domain terminology.
steps.text: এক মিনিট, aggregate percent মানে কি total marks? আমার তো 58% আছে, ওটা দিয়ে হবে না?

steps.purpose: Recover from the barge-in, clarify the term, and complete the eligibility explanation.
steps.text: হ্যাঁ, aggregate মানে আপনার সব subject মিলিয়ে total percentage। MBA-এর জন্য minimum 65% দরকার, তাই আপনি এই course-টার জন্য eligible নন। আপনার marks যদি 65% হতো, তাহলে আপনি qualify করতেন।

steps.purpose: Confirm understanding of the eligibility criteria and ask about an alternative course.
steps.text: আচ্ছা, মানে আমার 65% total লাগবে, আর আমার আছে 58%। তাই তো? তাহলে আমি কি PGDM-এ apply করতে পারি?

steps.purpose: Check eligibility for the alternative PGDM course requested by the user.
Return the eligibility result for the PGDM course.
Confirm eligibility for the alternative course and provide details.
steps.text: আমি চেক করে দেখলাম, হ্যাঁ, আপনি PGDM-এর জন্য apply করতে পারেন। এর জন্য minimum 50% দরকার, তাই আপনি eligible। এই course-এর annual fee 300000 টাকা।

steps.purpose: Request to submit the application for the PGDM course and ask about admission confirmation.
steps.text: আচ্ছা, তাহলে PGDM-এর জন্য application submit করে দিন। submit করলে কি আমার admission confirm হয়ে যাবে?

steps.purpose: Submit the application for the PGDM course as requested.
Return the submission result and reference number.
Provide the application reference and clarify that submission does not guarantee admission.
steps.text: আপনার application submit হয়ে গেছে। Reference number হল REF-9999 আর 7 দিনের মধ্যে decision জানানো হবে। তবে মনে রাখবেন, submit করা মানেই admission confirm নয়, admissions committee এটা review করবে।

ir.terminal_condition: Application submitted with a reference and the decision window stated.

variant_findings.reason: The assistant trails off its sentence in e10 ('minimum...'), allowing the user to barge in at e11 to ask for clarification on the term 'aggregate percent'. The assistant then answers the interruption and finishes the explanation in e12 without repeating the initial part of the sentence.
variant_findings.label: Turn Dynamics > Interruption Recovery > User Barge-in Recovery

variant_findings.reason: The assistant grounds all its claims and figures strictly in the tool outputs, including the 58% aggregate, 65% minimum for MBA, 50% minimum and 300000 fee for PGDM, and the 7-day decision window with REF-9999. It also explicitly avoids making an unsupported forward guarantee regarding admission confirmation in e20.
variant_findings.label: Tool Use > Tool Response Construction > Tool Output Grounding
